title: HTML Selector
body:
Matches every element with a given tag name. The plainest selector there is, and the one with
no punctuation in front of it.

```css
p    { color: grey; }
div  { padding: 1rem; }
```

Also called a type or element selector. Because it matches *all* of them, it is normally used
for document-wide defaults rather than for picking out one thing. See [[CSS Selectors]] and
[[HTML]].
